description: This file defines callback functions for nghttp2 session events within the http2 adapter namespace, used for handling HTTP/2 frame processing and extension payloads.

methods.name: OnReadyToSend
methods.description: Callback invoked when the library is ready to send serialized frames.

methods.name: OnBeginFrame
methods.description: Callback invoked when a frame header has been received.

methods.name: OnFrameReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when a complete frame has been received.

methods.name: OnBeginHeaders
methods.description: Callback invoked at the start of a headers frame.

methods.name: OnHeader
methods.description: Callback invoked when a name-value header has been received.

methods.name: OnBeforeFrameSent
methods.description: Callback invoked immediately before sending a frame.

methods.name: OnFrameSent
methods.description: Callback invoked immediately after a frame is sent.

methods.name: OnFrameNotSent
methods.description: Callback invoked when a non-DATA frame is not sent due to an error.

methods.name: OnInvalidFrameReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when an invalid frame is received.

methods.name: OnDataChunk
methods.description: Callback invoked when a chunk of data from a DATA frame payload has been received.

methods.name: OnStreamClosed
methods.description: Callback invoked when a stream has been closed.

methods.name: OnExtensionChunkReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when a chunk of extension frame data is passed to the application.

methods.name: OnUnpackExtensionCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when the application needs to unpack an extension payload.

methods.name: OnPackExtensionCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when nghttp2 wants to pack an extension payload; returns number of bytes serialized.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Callback invoked when the library has an error message to deliver.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Function to create a new nghttp2 session callbacks object.
